Metadata.title: When We Meet
Metadata.description: Find a time that works for everyone — no account needed.

Landing.heroAlt: Four friends raising a toast around a table, with a hand-drawn weekly calendar marked with stars for the times that work
Landing.tagline: Pick a date range, share the link, see when everyone's free. No account needed.

CreateRoom.timezoneHelp: Everyone in this room marks and sees times in this single timezone.

errors.endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after the start date
errors.dayEndBeforeStart: Daily end time must be after the daily start time
errors.rangeTooLong: Planning range can't be longer than 60 days
errors.dayStartHourRange: Daily start hour must be between 0 and 23
errors.dayEndHourRange: Daily end hour must be between 1 and 24

JoinForm.intro: You're about to join this room to mark which of the times above you're free. No account needed — just a name the rest of the group will see. Once you're in, you can see everyone's combined availability on the results page.
JoinForm.clickYourName: — click your name if it's you.
JoinForm.nameHelp: Must be unique in this room. If you come back later on a different browser or device to edit your marks, you'll need to enter this same name again.

collision.hasMarks: {name} already has marks in this room:
collision.noMarks: No marks yet — just an empty name reservation.

errors.confirmFailed: That didn't work — try entering your name again.
errors.roomFull: This room has reached its limit of {max} participants.

RoomPage.notYou: Not you? Use a different name
RoomPage.closedMessage: The meeting time has been set — availability marking is closed.

AvailabilityGrid.instructions: Click, or click and drag, to paint slots (works with touch too). "Prefer" only applies to slots already marked Can.

LeaveRoom.warning: This deletes your name and all your marks from this room. It can't be undone.

legend.clickToPick: Click a slot to set it as the meeting time

ResultsBoard.noSlotsYet: Nobody has marked any slots as available yet.

errors.notOwner: Only the room's creator can set the meeting time.
errors.outOfRange: That slot isn't in this room's range.
errors.notFuture: You can only pick a time in the future.
